newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin gets U.S. Army contract.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin gets U.S. Army contract.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp said on Monday it has received a U.S. Army contract to provide program management and systems integration for the Maneuver Control System Block IV.

The contract, valued at more than $86 million over five years with options, leverages Management & Data Systems' capabilities in large systems integration and capitalizes on the Lockheed Martin team's strengths with Army legacy systems, the company said.
Maneuver Control System provides tactical commanders and staffs below the corps level with automated capability for planning, coordinating and controlling tactical operations, the company said.
